title: Feasible Pairings for Decentralized Integral Controllability of Non-Square Systems
summary: This paper investigates the determination of feasible input-output pairings for the decentralized integral controllability of non-square systems. The relevance of this problem extends beyond traditional industrial processes into modern AI research, particularly Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where environments frequently act as strongly non-square mappings that evaluate high-dimensional joint action spaces via comparatively low-dimensional global rewards.
